title: Spiral Matrix
description:
Given an `m x n` integer `matrix`, return all elements of the `matrix` in clockwise spiral order.

Start at the top-left corner `(0, 0)` and move right across the top row, then down the rightmost column, then left across the bottom row, and then up the leftmost column, shrinking the unvisited boundary inward until every element has been visited exactly once.
hints: Maintain four boundary indices: top, bottom, left, and right, representing the unvisited rectangular layer.
After traversing the top row and right column, check that top <= bottom before traversing the bottom row, and left <= right before traversing the left column.
Each cell is visited exactly once, giving O(m * n) time and O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output list.

examples.explanation: Moving right (1,2,3), down (6,9), left (8,7), up (4), and right (5) visits all 9 elements.
Outer border yields [1,2,3,4,8,12,11,10,9,5], leaving the inner row [6,7].
A single-row matrix is traversed once from left to right.
